script.description: rewrite add_date from dd-MMM-yy to ISO with a 1900/2000 century pivot
script.source: if (ctx.add_date == null) { return; } String raw = ctx.add_date.toString().trim().toUpperCase(); if (raw.length() == 0) { ctx.remove('add_date'); return; } def parts = /-/.split(raw); if (parts.length != 3) { ctx.remove('add_date'); return; } /* ISO passthrough: mirrors parse_flexible_date's fromisoformat-first order in matching/signals.py. Without this, reindexing an already-processed document (whose add_date is now ISO) would silently delete the field below, since the middle part (e.g. '05') never matches the Oracle month table. */ if (parts[0] ==~ /[0-9]{4}/ && parts[1] ==~ /[0-9]{2}/ && parts[2] ==~ /[0-9]{2}/) { return; } def months = ['JAN':1,'FEB':2,'MAR':3,'APR':4,'MAY':5,'JUN':6,'JUL':7,'AUG':8,'SEP':9,'OCT':10,'NOV':11,'DEC':12]; if (!months.containsKey(parts[1])) { ctx.remove('add_date'); return; } int day = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]); int year = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]); if (parts[2].length() == 2) { year = year > 30 ? 1900 + year : 2000 + year; } ctx.add_date = String.format('%04d-%02d-%02d', new def[]{year, months[parts[1]], day});
